about.summary: Lead Fullstack Developer with 1.5+ years of experience building production-ready applications. Specialized in MERN stack, Next.js, React, real-time systems, and role-based platforms.

professionalExperience.description: Built healthcare & beauty reservation platform from scratch with multi-role access (Admin, Owner, Manager, Collaborator, Client), real-time notifications, admin dashboards, Flutter mobile app, and production deployment. Designed full system architecture including databases, APIs, and authentication logic.

Developed restaurant POS and management system with role-based access (Owner, Manager, Waiter), multi-space support, real-time table ordering, stock management, receipt printing, and analytics. Currently serving 10 active client restaurants.
